subject: Founders First: seed program credits for portfolio startups
thread_body:
From: Sara Lin <sara@foundervc.org>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Founders First — request: credits for seed cohort (multiple startups)

Hi Alex,

Hope you’re well — Founders First runs a rolling seed cohort and we’d like to provide a credits benefit to a batch of three portfolio companies (BrightData Labs, LumenAI, Orex).

Quick ask: can Redwood provide self-serve promo credits for each company (up to $5k per company) and a way for us to verify eligibility programmatically? We have a consolidated roster and acceptance letter we can share. A couple follow-ups:
- Is there a promo code or program flow we can use so founders redeem themselves?
- Can credits be issued with 6-month expiration and possible 90-day extension for pilot projects?
- Any privacy/security checklist we need to pass for program-wide issuance?

Attaching the roster CSV for initial view — happy to redact PII if you need. If it helps, Dan Park at BrightData is copied and can be a test candidate.

Thanks —
Sara Lin
Program Director, Founders First Accelerator
partner@foundervc.org
Attachment: FF_ACCT_LIST.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

-----Original Message Received-----

From: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@foundervc.org>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders First — request: credits for seed cohort (multiple startups)

Sara — thanks for the note and the roster. We can absolutely support a program flow for multiple startups. High-level response and next steps: 

1) Self-serve issuance: we have a promo code flow that supports accelerator partners. I can enable a partner code (example: FF2026-SEP) that allows founders to redeem up to $5,000 each via our self-serve credits portal.

2) Expiration/extension: standard issuance is 6 months; we can support a one-time 90-day extension on a per-account basis for pilot customers. We’ll document the process and provide a single form for founders to request an extension.

3) Verification: to keep it low-friction we accept either (a) a signed cohort acceptance letter from the accelerator, or (b) a verified email domain on the founders' accounts plus a short intake form. For program-level issuance we prefer the signed letter + roster.

4) Security/compliance: for program credits we do not require SOC 2 for founders, but if any company requests Dedicated or Private deployment we'll need the usual security questionnaire. For bulk issuance we can provide the minimal evidence items in one package.

Action items: 
- Can you confirm the final roster and provide a signed accelerator acceptance letter (one PDF covering the three startups)?
- We’ll need a primary contact for disputes/invoicing (billing contact).

I’ve attached a short template letter you can use to streamline this (accelerator-credit-template.docx). If you prefer, I can enable the code now and you can distribute it, and we’ll perform a quick verification pass before credits are activated.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Attachment: accelerator-credit-template.docx (DOCX, 18 KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Sara Lin <sara@foundervc.org>
To: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dan Park <dan@brightdatalabs.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders First — request: credits for seed cohort (multiple startups)

Thanks Alex — attaching a signed acceptance letter (one PDF) and the finalized roster. We’d like to treat BrightData as the pilot (they go live this week) and then open to the other two the following month. Two quick asks: 
- Can BrightData get a 90-day trial extension on top of redemption?
- We’d prefer credits to be issued immediately upon redemption (no manual hold).

Attached: FF_Signed_Acceptance.pdf, FF_ACCT_LIST_FINAL.csv

Best,
Sara

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders First — request: credits for seed cohort (multiple startups)

Looping in billing/ops notes —
- We can enable promo code FF2026-SEP today. It will allow self-serve redemptions up to $5,000 per account.
- Redemption will apply credits immediately when a founder redeems (no manual hold) — we’ll enable automatic issuance for accelerator codes.
- Expirations set to 6 months by default; we’ll add a flag for a one-time 90-day extension request handled by support.

For record keeping I created a deal in HubSpot: RDW-ACC-2026-117 and linked the roster. Posting the link here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/RDW-ACC-2026-117

Dev Patel
Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders First — request: credits for seed cohort (multiple startups)

Alex/Sara — I’m the BrightData point person. Quick technical question: our initial workload is 1k-4k tokens/sec with batch inference across 2 models — any guidance on expected unit consumption vs value of credits? Also, can you share the redemption link to test?

Thanks,
Dan Park
Co-founder, BrightData Labs
Attachment: workload_sample.txt (TXT, 4 KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: alex_martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dan Park <dan@brightdatalabs.com>, Sara Lin <sara@foundervc.org>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Founders First — request: credits for seed cohort (multiple startups)

Dan — thanks, and welcome. Two quick answers: 
- For a rough estimate: for streaming generation-level workloads your consumption will depend on sequence lengths and model choice. A back-of-envelope: 1k tokens/sec sustained at a mid-sized model translates to ~Rs 1.2–2.5k of credits/day depending on prompt/context; we’ll run a short eval if you want a more accurate mapping.
- Redemption/testing link (redeem here): https://app.redwood.ai/credits/redeem/FF2026-SEP

Sara/Dev — I’ve enabled FF2026-SEP and activated it for the three accounts listed in the roster after we verified the signed acceptance. Attached is the issuance manifest for our records.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai
